headline: Solar marketing agency in Ghaziabad: a locality-by-locality plan for installers
card_text: Trans-Hindon societies, old plotted colonies, Raj Nagar Extension towers and Sahibabad factories each buy solar differently. Here's how Ghaziabad installers can plan campaigns around them.
intro:
Search for a solar company in Ghaziabad and you'll see installers that already have separate pages for Indirapuram, Vaishali, Vasundhara, Kaushambi, Crossings Republik and Raj Nagar Extension. That tells you two things. Buyers in Ghaziabad search by locality, not just by city, and the competition for those searches is already active. A solar marketing agency in Ghaziabad has to plan around that, rather than run one generic "solar panels Ghaziabad" campaign.

This guide is for installers, EPCs and dealers selling rooftop solar in Ghaziabad district. It breaks the city into the buyer groups that matter, covers the local facts your ads must get right, and sets out how to judge whether your marketing is paying for itself. It draws on the work we do with 30+ solar EPCs and manufacturers across India.

sections.h2: Why Ghaziabad needs its own solar marketing plan
sections.html:
Ghaziabad sits right on the Delhi border, so it's easy to treat it as part of an "East Delhi and NCR" campaign. That usually costs money, for three reasons:

  • Different state, different rules. Ghaziabad is in Uttar Pradesh. Its subsidy top-up, net-metering regulations and DISCOM are not the same as Delhi's, so a Delhi-focused ad or landing page gives Ghaziabad buyers the wrong information.
  • Very mixed housing. Within a few kilometres you'll find old independent houses, GDA-developed sectors, builder floors and large high-rise townships. Each one has a different decision-maker and a different roof situation.
  • Locality-level searching. People type "solar panel installation Indirapuram" or "solar company Raj Nagar Extension", and local installers are already ranking for those terms. You need locality signals on your Google Business Profile, website and ads to compete.

A plan built around Ghaziabad's localities will cost less per site visit than one that simply draws a circle around the whole city.

sections.h2: Local facts your ads and calls must get right
sections.html:
Ghaziabad buyers often hear about solar from relatives in Delhi or Noida, so they arrive with mixed information. Keep these points accurate:

  • DISCOM. Ghaziabad is served by Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (PVVNL), the UP state DISCOM for the western region. Net-metering applications, meter replacement and load enhancement go through PVVNL, so ask for a recent bill before you explain the process.
  • Central subsidy. Under PM Surya Ghar, eligible residential consumers can get central financial assistance of up to ₹78,000 for a system of 3 kW or more, with separate support for RWAs and group housing societies. Check pmsuryaghar.gov.in for the current figures before each campaign.
  • UP state top-up. Uttar Pradesh has offered an extra state subsidy for residential rooftop systems, announced at ₹15,000 per kW up to ₹30,000. State support depends on budget and can change, so confirm the current position with UPNEDA before naming any amount.
  • Net metering. UP rooftop solar follows the UPERC rooftop regulations, which have been revised more than once. Say net metering is available subject to DISCOM approval and keep your wording in line with the current rules.
  • Sanctioned load. A home system usually can't exceed the connection's sanctioned load. Many older Ghaziabad houses have low sanctioned loads, so mention load enhancement on the first call.

Never say "free solar" or present a subsidy as guaranteed. Our guide to PM Surya Ghar subsidy ads has wording that stays accurate when schemes change.

sections.h2: Local SEO: competing for locality searches
sections.html:
Because Ghaziabad competitors already rank with locality pages, organic and Maps visibility is where a lot of cheap enquiries come from. As a solar marketing agency working across NCR, this is the order we work in:

  1. Google Business Profile first. Set accurate service areas for the Ghaziabad localities you cover, use the right categories, upload real installation photos and post updates regularly.
  2. Locality pages with real substance. A page for Indirapuram or Raj Nagar should show projects you've actually done there, the housing types you work with and the PVVNL process. Thin pages that only swap the place name rarely hold rankings.
  3. Reviews that mention the area. Ask every installed customer for a Google review soon after commissioning. Reviews that naturally mention the locality and the service help both rankings and trust.
  4. Hindi and Hinglish queries. Many Ghaziabad homeowners search in Hindi or mixed language, such as "solar panel lagwane ka kharcha" or "subsidy kaise milegi". Answer these on your FAQ pages and in videos.

Our local SEO services page explains the Maps side in more detail.

sections.h2: Paid ads setup for Ghaziabad installers
sections.html:
Paid ads bring volume faster than SEO, but Ghaziabad's position between Delhi and Noida makes targeting easy to get wrong.

  • Target by locality, not by city pin. On Meta, use pincodes or tight radiuses around the colonies and sectors you serve. On Google, add the localities as locations and check the location report each week for clicks from outside your area.
  • Separate Ghaziabad from Delhi. Keep Ghaziabad in its own campaign so your ads and landing page can talk about UP subsidy and PVVNL rather than Delhi's rules.
  • Qualify in the form. Ask whether they own the property, the house type, the locality and the average monthly bill. This filters out tenants and flat owners before your team calls.
  • Use negatives on Google. Exclude jobs, training, franchise, dealership and "solar panel price list" searches if you don't want price-only shoppers.
  • Show local proof. Short videos of real installations in recognisable Ghaziabad areas usually beat stock images. Use them only with the customer's permission.

For a full Meta setup, see our step-by-step guide to Facebook ads for solar installers.

sections.h2: Selling to Ghaziabad factories and societies
sections.html:
Industrial areas such as Sahibabad and the Meerut Road and Bulandshahr Road belts have many small and mid-sized units that run mostly in daytime, which suits solar. These are slower, larger sales:

  • Ask for 12 months of bills and the sanctioned load before quoting.
  • Lead with an estimated payback based on their bills, not a headline percentage.
  • Explain capex and RESCO or OPEX options plainly if you offer both.
  • Expect several meetings, and check whether the shed is owned or rented.

Google Search, LinkedIn and direct outreach usually work better for these buyers than broad Meta campaigns. For high-rise societies in Raj Nagar Extension, Crossings Republik and Indirapuram, find the RWA treasurer or facility manager who sees the common-area bill, size the proposal honestly to the free roof area, and put answers on waterproofing, maintenance and warranty in writing. Our guide to solar marketing in Noida covers the RWA process in more depth, since Noida and Ghaziabad societies follow a similar pattern.

sections.h2: How to judge whether your Ghaziabad marketing is working
sections.html:
Track every lead from source to installation, and review these numbers weekly by locality:

  1. Cost per qualified enquiry (owner, right house type, serviceable area)
  2. Time from enquiry to first call
  3. Cost per site visit
  4. Quote-to-install rate
  5. New Google reviews and Maps calls

If one locality brings cheap leads that never book a visit, cut it or change the offer there. For reference, our rooftop campaigns run at ₹60–80 per qualified enquiry when they're working well, and solar clients at scale typically get 20–30 leads a day and 5–10 site visits a week. Your results will depend on your localities, offer and follow-up speed, and no honest agency can promise them in advance.

We start with a 90-day sprint and then move to a flexible arrangement. You can see examples of the work in our solar portfolio: the Solarxp website, Sungrid's Google reviews and local SEO, Skynxt Solar's video and social, and RK Solar's lead generation.

faqs: Which is the best solar marketing agency in Ghaziabad?

Look for an agency that focuses on solar, can show solar case studies and reports cost per site visit rather than just cost per lead. Performance and Pixel is a solar-focused marketing agency serving installers across Delhi NCR, including Ghaziabad, from our office in Dwarka, New Delhi.
Which DISCOM handles solar net metering in Ghaziabad?

Ghaziabad is served by PVVNL (Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited). Net-metering and load enhancement applications go through PVVNL, so check the customer's bill and PVVNL's current process before explaining it.
Is there a UP state solar subsidy for Ghaziabad homes?

Uttar Pradesh has offered a state top-up for residential rooftop solar on top of the central PM Surya Ghar assistance. Amounts and availability can change, so confirm the current scheme with UPNEDA before using any figure in ads or quotes.
Should Ghaziabad be in the same ad campaign as Delhi?

It's better to run Ghaziabad separately. Ghaziabad follows Uttar Pradesh's subsidy and net-metering rules and is served by PVVNL, so its ads and landing page need different information from a Delhi campaign.
How much does solar marketing cost for a Ghaziabad installer?

It depends on your ad budget, the localities you target and the agency fee. Our rooftop campaigns run at ₹60–80 per qualified enquiry when working well, but your cost will depend on your offer and how quickly your team follows up.
